- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The film industry has implemented changes such as increased testing, wearing masks and personal protective equipment, physical distancing, and smaller crew sizes to ensure safety on set.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The pandemic has led to the closure of many movie theaters, resulting in a rise in streaming services and online releases.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Studios have begun to release films directly to streaming platforms or on-demand rental services, bypassing traditional theatrical releases.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some changes made during the pandemic, such as increased safety measures on film sets and a greater emphasis on streaming content, are likely to become permanent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is expected that theaters will reopen and traditional theatrical releases will resume, possibly with more flexibility in release dates and simultaneous streaming options.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The reduced cost and accessibility of producing and distributing films online may make it easier for independent filmmakers to create and release their work.
